Krampusnacht

Krampusnacht Festivities at Home

Celebrate the thrilling Alpine tradition of Krampusnacht with a day filled with playful scares, festive treats, and cozy moments. Embrace the spirit of the night by honoring the folklore and enjoying traditional foods.

  1. Afternoon

    Prepare Festive Treats

    Begin by baking gingerbread hearts and pretzels, and cooking spicy sausages to enjoy later. These traditional snacks will fuel the evening's festivities and bring authentic flavors to your celebration.

    Recipes: Traditional Gingerbread Cookies for Krampusnacht · Traditional Soft Pretzels · Spicy Sausages

  2. Early Evening

    Dress Up and Decorate

    Create simple Krampus costumes or masks to mimic the traditional figures. Decorate your home with chains and rustic Alpine elements to set the spooky yet festive atmosphere.

  3. Evening

    Krampus Parade and Scare Games

    Reenact the Krampus parade with family or friends, rattling chains and staging playful scares to honor the folklore. Take photos with the Krampus characters to capture the fun and bravery of the night.

  4. After the Parade

    Enjoy Traditional Drinks and Snacks

    Warm up with schnapps and nibble on the gingerbread hearts, spicy sausages, and pretzels prepared earlier. These treats are perfect for calming the adrenaline and sharing stories about the night's adventures.

    Recipes: Homemade Spiced Schnapps · Traditional Gingerbread Cookies for Krampusnacht · Spicy Sausages · Traditional Soft Pretzels

  5. Night

    Storytelling by the Fire

    Gather around a cozy fire or warm spot to share tales of St. Nicholas and the Krampus, passing down the folklore and reflecting on the night’s fun and lessons.

End the day feeling connected to Alpine tradition, warmed by good food and the thrill of Krampusnacht.
